item.title: AEW star Kenny Omega busts out classic Alex cosplay to kick off Capcom Cup 12 festivities on the Street Fighter 6 stage
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/mar/10/capcom-cup-12-results/">Capcom Cup 12</a> is now underway, and <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/mar/03/alex-character-guide-sf6/">Alex</a> will finally be making his way to Street Fighter 6 next week.</p> <p>To kick off the week of festivities, AEW star Kenny Omega took to the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a> stage, and he came dressed up for the occasion.</p>

item.title: UltraDavid releases his final Season 3 tier list for Street Fighter 6 before the big balance patch
item.description: <p>Longtime competitor and commentator <a href='https://x.com/ultradavid/status/2029262038883811636'>UltraDavid</a> has released his final tier list for Street Fighter 6 Season 3. <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/21/alex-gameplay-trailer-sf6/'>Alex</a> is set to join the roster on March 17, 2026. Alongside him, there will be a <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/27/street-fighter-balance-update/'>major balance patch</a> that will supposedly affect every combatant.</p
